segment.title: Select and fix a part
segment.stage: Picture to select from (click to point)
segment.hint: Click what you want to fix or keep. Click elsewhere to add more, or switch to "Leave out" to take back what spilled over.
segment.firstRun: The first time takes a while because the selection model is fetched.
segment.done: Done. The blue part is the selection.
segment.cutout: Cut out the selection and save
segment.cutoutSaved: The cut-out is saved to the gallery
segment.needsPack: Selecting a part needs the extension {pack}.
segment.eraseHint: Fills the selection from the picture around it. It looks natural when a LaMa model is installed, and rough otherwise.
segment.erased: The picture with the part erased is saved to the gallery
segment.lama.offer: You can get LaMa (about 200 MB) to erase more cleanly. Without it a rougher fill is used.
segment.redraw.title: Redraw the selection
segment.redraw.hint: Only the selected part is redrawn from your text; the rest stays. Lowering "How much it changes" keeps more of the original shapes and colors. It works best in the wording the model likes (tags for an anime model, for example).
segment.redraw.prompt: What to draw (for example: blue hair, red scarf)
segment.redraw.done: The redrawn picture is saved to the gallery
segment.mosaic: Save with the selection as a mosaic
segment.mosaicSaved: Saved the mosaic picture to the gallery
